topic: How does the dual-mode operation of the CTS antenna impact frequency reuse and coverage patterns in Ka-band satellite architectures?
consensus_response: Dual-mode CTS antennas enhance frequency reuse via polarization diversity, but quasi-TE1 mode's gain drop limits coverage. Phased arrays and digital beamforming compensate for this limitation, optimizing spectral efficiency and link quality. Beam hopping techniques further improve spectral efficiency by dynamically allocating beams.
reference_context: Ka-band systems offer higher bandwidths, but are susceptible to weather conditions, requiring careful antenna design and beam management.
